editionLabel: Bezier Games English base rules, official Dized reference
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently won any game is the first Slicer. After that player divides the pizza, their left-hand neighbor chooses the first portion.
houseFallback: If the latest-win criterion does not select one player, agree to choose the initial Slicer randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The Slicer begins the round by revealing a pizza and Special, then dividing them into portions.
Portion choices proceed clockwise from the Slicer's left. The Slicer receives the last portion.
The player on the Slicer's left becomes the Slicer for the next round.

internalEvidence: Read all 8 cached rule-section bodies for this game, including relevant variants. Its index identifies Bezier Games and explicitly describes these as publisher-maintained official rules. Determine First Slicer says last to win any game, not the previous New York Slice winner specifically. Round setup, strategic slicing and first portion selection are distinct; the Slicer's left neighbor chooses first. Two-player setup removes specific slices without replacing that order.
